text:
Ashley (Vertex Labs): Hey team — our daily usage CSV for Vertex Labs looks off. Our org timezone is Asia/Singapore (UTC+8) but the CSV has the majority of 2024-04-12 usage stamped as 2024-04-11. This is causing billing confusion.
Maya: Sorry about that, Ashley. Can you paste a couple sample rows (timestamp + recorded day) and confirm where you downloaded the export from (Console -> Billing -> Export)?
Ashley (Vertex Labs): Downloaded from Console -> Billing -> Exports. Sample rows:

user_id,org_id,request_ts,usage_day,tokens
u123,vertex-labs,2024-04-12T01:15:23Z,2024-04-11,1245
u456,vertex-labs,2024-04-12T03:02:10Z,2024-04-11,300

So requests are in UTC on Apr 12 but usage_day shows Apr 11.
Maya: Thanks. I'm escalating to analytics and eng-oncall.
Maya: @Sam (eng-oncall) @Lina can one of you take a look? This looks like a day-bucketing mismatch between exports and the Console UI.
Sam (eng-oncall): On it. Quick question: do we currently compute the 'usage_day' at ingestion or at export time?
Lina: We compute the canonical usage_day at ingestion using date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), store that, and the Console UI applies org timezone when displaying. Exports are reading the stored bucket directly (so it's anchored to UTC day boundaries). That explains the shift for orgs east of UTC.
Sam (eng-oncall): Got it — so export pipeline is picking the stored UTC bucket instead of converting to the org's timezone. Confirmed bug.
Maya: Repro steps for engineering:
1) Set org timezone to Asia/Singapore (UTC+8)
2) Send a request at 2024-04-12T01:15:23Z (UTC)
3) Export CSV for 2024-04-12
Expected: row shows usage_day 2024-04-12 (org-local day)
Actual: row shows usage_day 2024-04-11 (UTC day)

Lina: Quick SQL proof-of-concept (what export currently does):
```
SELECT org_id, date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as usage_day_utc, sum(tokens)
FROM events
WHERE org_id = 'vertex-labs' AND created_at >= '2024-04-11' AND created_at < '2024-04-13'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
We need to compute usage_day in org tz for exports instead:
```
SELECT org_id, (date_trunc('day', (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE org_tz))::date as usage_day_org, sum(tokens)
FROM events JOIN orgs ON events.org_id = orgs.id
...
```
Maya: Temporary workaround for Ashley: you can set the export timezone param to your org timezone in the export UI (we'll surface this as a checkbox) or I'll regenerate today's export with Asia/Singapore tz and DM you the file.
Ashley (Vertex Labs): Please regenerate, we need it for our internal billing reconciliation.
Omar (Billing): Flagging from billing side — any impacted days where totals moved >5% should get a manual review, possible credit. Keep me posted on the backfill window.
Jasper (PM): This is P1 for correctness of billing data. Lina/Sam — please estimate fix + backfill time. We need a changelist: export pipeline change + backfill script + UI param.
Lina: Estimate: 4h to push export change (export job now honors org_tz), 6-8h to run backfill for last 7 days (depends on cluster throughput), add tests + rollout = 1 business day.
Sam (eng-oncall): I'll take ownership of the rollout and smoke tests. Will post CI link and coordinate with eng-platform if we need a maintenance window for heavy backfill.
export-bot: export job 2024-04-13T05:02:41Z completed for vertex-labs (tz=Asia/Singapore).
Maya: Uploaded regenerated CSV to the support thread and DM'd Ashley. Ashley, please confirm when you download and reconcile.
Ashley (Vertex Labs): Got it, downloading now. Quick check looks correct for the samples we shared. Thanks!
Maya: Follow-ups: Lina to open a small RFC for changing the canonical stored bucket vs dynamic display/export conversion. For now we'll change export to convert stored UTC bucket to org tz at export time to avoid schema changes.
Lina: Filed analytics ticket: AN-1426. I'll include test cases for edge days (DST transitions, orgs with half-hour offsets).
Omar: Once backfill completes, I'll run a billing diff and follow up with credits if needed.
Jasper: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer-facing status and the Known Issues doc.
Maya: marking resolved for this thread after Ashley confirms recon.
Ashley (Vertex Labs): Confirmed, thanks for quick turnaround :tada:
